findings.title: Missing security header: strict-transport-security
findings.evidence: Response did not set strict-transport-security (enforces HTTPS on future visits (HSTS)).

findings.title: Missing security header: x-content-type-options
findings.evidence: Response did not set x-content-type-options (stops the browser guessing/sniffing a response's MIME type).

findings.title: Missing security header: x-frame-options
findings.evidence: Response did not set x-frame-options (mitigates clickjacking by controlling framing).

findings.title: Missing security header: content-security-policy
findings.evidence: Response did not set content-security-policy (restricts which sources scripts/styles/etc. may load from).

findings.title: Missing security header: referrer-policy
findings.evidence: Response did not set referrer-policy (controls how much of the URL is leaked to other sites via the Referer header).
